name: Chest Press
setup: Sit down and adjust the seat so the handles are level with the middle of your chest.
Keep your back flat against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Push the handles forward until your arms are almost straight, then slowly bring them back.

name: Lat Pulldown
setup: Sit down and lower the thigh pad so it holds your legs snugly.
Grab the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, then let it rise slowly.

name: Leg Press
setup: Sit back in the seat and place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through your heels until your legs are almost straight. Don't lock your knees.

name: Seated Row
setup: Sit with your feet on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle and sit up tall with your chest out.
Pull the handle to your belly button, squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly.

name: Shoulder Press
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight, then lower slowly.

name: Leg Curl
setup: Sit down and adjust the pad so it rests just above your heels.
Set the thigh pad so it holds your legs in place.
Pull your heels toward you, then slowly let them go back up.

name: Leg Extension
setup: Sit down so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point (the round joint on the side).
Rest the pad on the lower part of your shins, just above your feet.
Straighten your legs, pause for a moment, then lower slowly.
